# Notes Reveal

A personal note is typed character by character with a caret, the page scrolling up as each line lands, then it cuts to a paper card with a marker headline and a ticked checklist.

Category: ui-blocks. Length: 24.85 s. WebGL: no.

Use when:
- A story told as one person's typed note, ending on a hand-lettered card with a checklist, as a vertical ad.
- A calm personal tone with a clear payoff.

Avoid when:
- The scene should be short: it runs about 25 seconds.
- You need a different app mock-up: this is a notes page with a keyboard.

Variables:
- titleL1 (string): Note title line 1, default "Things nobody told me"
- titleL2 (string): Note title line 2, default "about video."
- noteLine1 (string): Note body line 1, default "my posts got no views"
- noteLine2 (string): Note body line 2, default "editing took my whole weekend"
- noteLine3 (string): Note body line 3, default "and re-edits never end."
- noteLine4 (string): Note body line 4, default "then i tried writing a script"
- noteLine5 (string): Note body line 5, default "built the whole video in an afternoon"
- noteLine6 (string): Note body line 6, default "the grind is gone, but more than that -"
- noteLine7 (string): Note body line 7, default "I post a video every week."
- cardTop (string): Card headline top, default "THE POWER"
- cardMid (string): Card headline middle, default "OF"
- cardBottom (string): Card headline bottom, default "ONE IDEA"
- check1Label (string): Checklist 1 label, default "WRITE"
- check1Value (string): Checklist 1 value, default "SCRIPT"
- check2Label (string): Checklist 2 label, default "SHOOT"
- check2Value (string): Checklist 2 value, default "IN 4K"
- check3Label (string): Checklist 3 label, default "SHIP"
- check3Value (string): Checklist 3 value, default "TODAY"
- brandDomain (string): Sign-off domain, default "yourbrand.com"
- noteBackground (color): Card scene background, default "#ece1d5"

Source: heygen-com/hyperframes. Licence: Apache-2.0. The scene file keeps the upstream notice.
